about: What each recorded DeepSeek Harness profile may hold: the exact spec of every direct dependency in its package.json. scripts/dsh-profiles compares this machine's profiles with it.

sources.dsh-tui: The set canon/upstreams.json records under deepseek-harness at dsh-v0.2.2-rc.2 (ADR 0045), at the versions a rehearsal installed on 2026-11-13, and dsh-tui itself at its pin. Stock is the recorded set less three of its plugins: dsh-advisor, dsh-llm-fallbacks and dsh-github-skills (ADR 0086 rule 1's 2026-11-13 pointer). dsh-fail-guard was installed but never recorded, and it leaves too. The review configuration's terminal bundle is left out: at that pin its panel backend needs the Web bundle's terminal controller, which no worker profile composes (ADR 0086 rule 2's 2026-11-13 pointer; the bundle's registry entry). The registry gives aegis as 2.15.0 at commit e5f43c548a06, and the whole commit in its evidence.
sources.headless: ADR 0086 rule 3, the build configuration, with its first-party packages moved to 0.2.2-rc.2 with the engine pin on 2026-11-13. It also holds the two hook packages that the worker-parity row of 2026-11-11 in the profile's own patch loads, as review-acp and build-acp record them; ADR 0086 rule 3 does not name them. The rule names aegis without a version, so the aegis commit here is UNVERIFIED for this profile: it is the one ADR 0086's 2026-11-11 amendment records for both ACP profiles, which GitHub's commits API named the merge of release/v2.15.0 on 2026-11-13. At that pin dsh-base composes fs-observation-policy disabled, so this profile runs without read-before-write; no lane dispatches it, and a row restores the guard before one does (ADR 0136's 2026-11-13 line).
sources.review-acp: ADR 0086, the 2026-11-11 amendment's ACP profile table, with its first-party packages moved to 0.2.2-rc.2 with the engine pin on 2026-11-13, less the terminal bundle: at that pin its panel backend needs the Web bundle's terminal controller, which no worker profile composes (ADR 0095 item 4's 2026-11-13 pointer; the bundle's registry entry). At that pin dsh-base composes fs-observation-policy disabled, so this profile runs without read-before-write; no lane dispatches it, and a row restores the guard before one does (ADR 0136's 2026-11-13 line).
